messages:
maria_support: ACME reports a bunch of requests routing to EU even though their client sets region=us-east. They say it started after rolling out an edge proxy in front of our SDK.
acme_ops: Confirmed — our SDK sets `X-Client-Region: us-east` but traces show blank header arriving at the edge. Billing is wrong & latency spikes.
maria_support: Attached logs from customer (redacted):
```
Incoming request from 35.180.12.9
X-Client-Region: 
X-Forwarded-For: 35.180.12.9
URL: /v1/generate?model=redwood-1
```
jamal_ops: Repro attempt from our test app behind the same proxy. Curl we used:
```
curl -v -H "X-Client-Region: us-east" "https://edge-proxy.acme.example/v1/generate"
```
jamal_ops: At the backend we see no X-Client-Region header. Proxy removes it when value isn't token-like (something about header sanitization). :thinking:
eng_ryan: Could be the proxy's header whitelist or Fastly/VCL rule that drops empty/unknown headers. Also some CDNs strip headers with underscores unless configured.
alex: We prioritize header > query param > geo by default. If header disappears, router falls back to customer default which for ACME is EU (they had older account settings). That explains misroute + billing.
maria_support: Customer says SDK used to set region query param earlier; in migration they switched to header. Might be sending `X-Client-Region:` with no value in some codepaths.
jamal_ops: Quick repro steps:
1) Send header but with empty string: `-H \"X-Client-Region: \"`
2) Proxy strips header entirely
3) Router sees no region and picks EU fallback
Workaround for customer: explicitly set `region=us-east` in querystring or send a non-empty sentinel `X-Client-Region: us-east`
routing-bot: Observed 12 similar events in last 6 hours for customers behind edge proxies. Pattern: blank header values -> fallback to account default (often EU).
eng_ryan: Suggested fixes:
- Short term: routing change to treat missing header as \"unknown\" and prefer query param or request IP geo before account default
- Mid term: add strict validation in SDKs to refuse empty region header; emit warning
- Ops: update our edge proxy doc to call out header stripping behavior for common CDNs (Fastly, CloudFront) and recommended header names (no underscores)
jamal_ops: Filed internal ops ticket OPS-8721 to update VCL and add header passthrough for `X-Client-Region` and to log when header was dropped.
maria_support: Sent ACME remediation steps and asked them to toggle query param for now. ACME will test and report back.
acme_ops: Will test now and report latency. Thanks!
alex: I'll schedule a short config change to router priority and patch SDKs in a follow-up PR. Tracking: ENG-PR-451.
maria_support: Marking as escalated -> eng + ops. Will update once ACME confirms mitigation. :thumbsup:
